EX-99.1 2 aura-ex99_1.htm EX-99.1 EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Aura Biosciences Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Business Highlights Phase 3 CoMpass trial on track for topline data in 2H 2027; all participants have completed treatment visits Established relationship with industry-leading CDMO providing designated manufacturing capacity for bel-sar Early choroidal melanoma investor and analyst virtual event planned for December 8, 2026 Expected cash runway into 1H 2029 BOSTON, MA – November 9, 2026 – Aura Biosciences, Inc.

“With all treatment visits completed in the CoMpass trial, our team is focused on ensuring excellence in all elements of the bel-sar program as we advance toward topline pivotal data in the second half of next year and position bel-sar as the first potential vision-preserving front-line therapy for early choroidal melanoma.” Recent Business Highlights Phase 3 CoMpass Trial in Early Choroidal Melanoma Enrollment is complete with 108 participants in the Phase 3 CoMpass trial of belzupacap sarotalocan (bel-sar) for the treatment of early choroidal melanoma, the most common primary tumor of the eye which carries an approximately 50% risk of advancing to metastatic disease.
The trial is on track to deliver topline data from the 15-month primary endpoint in the second half of 2027.

“We are very pleased to enter this new CDMO relationship, which we believe positions bel-sar for regulatory and commercial success as we advance toward topline data and completion of the CoMpass study,” said Susan Abu-Absi, Ph.D., Chief Operating Officer of Aura Biosciences.
